# Parrot CTFs

> > Enterprise-grade Capture The Flag (CTF) competition hosting and cybersecurity event infrastructure by Lorikeet Security, featuring custom challenges, real-time scoreboards, and compliance-ready platforms for technical hiring and security training.

Parrot CTFs provides professional CTF event hosting services with enterprise features including SOC 2, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, CMMC, and GDPR compliance. The platform supports custom challenge development, real-time scoring, and is powered by Lory AI for enhanced competition experiences.
